The information timestamp adapter follows CPython 3.14.2 datetime parsing and
validation behavior, including its documented source order and return codes.
CPython is Copyright (c) 2001 Python Software Foundation. All rights reserved.
The applicable PSF license/history notices are retained in PYTHON-LICENSE.txt.

Reference source URL/hash, Python helper hash, Unicode version and generated
table/fixture hashes are pinned in python-time-provenance.json. The Unicode
nonprinting ranges were generated from the original Python str.isprintable
behavior to preserve error representations without changing accepted data.

The adapter preserves the reference's zero-whole-second timezone behavior,
24:00 rollover, and offset normalization solely for language-migration parity.
This does not change any archived metadata or assert that those conventions
are desirable for a future, separately versioned data-availability policy.
